report:
Reviewed the complete interface_dependencies claim, the sole ordinary expr.rs implementation association, and both associated tests. Verified exact byte equality of all three current implementation/test files against the historical input snapshots; historical rationale is baseline context, not new execution evidence.
Fresh source reassessment: expression traversal uses its own source_stash; paths request resolution; def_to_ty reads local callee signatures, instantiates parameters/return types and submits interface obligations without requesting callee bodies. Field and ADT paths request demanded signatures/fields; method/operator paths delegate semantic resolution. This supports the interface boundary for the inspected expressions, not a proof of the entire transitive query graph.
The complete clone_method_body_has_a_narrow_reusable_semantic_query_trace test visibly asserts the exact five selected associated-item/trait/function metadata calls, absence of recorded body calls, the external item-name dependency, initial body query execution, no warm metadata calls and no warm body query execution. Captured force_db_method establishes that the requested local db method body is actually checked with no diagnostics. Captured tracing/record and signature metadata helpers establish the selected trace instrumentation. This would catch extra selected metadata reads or failure of the asserted warm reuse, but does not exhaustively whitelist local queries or demonstrate edit isolation.
The explicit TODO checking_body_interface_dependencies correctly retains those missing cases: a complete cold whitelist rejecting every callee-body/unrelated-interface read, generalized unchanged warm no-work behavior, and persistent relevant-interface versus unrelated-body edits. Its prerequisite is implementation of that broader instrumented query/edit verification matrix; the empty body is not behavioral evidence. Own CST/signature and demanded resolution/interface/metadata/candidate/solver restrictions, and the absolute cross-body prohibition, therefore remain only partially verified with the remainder explicitly deferred. No N/A or other associations exist. This reassessment accepts the documented verification deferral, not complete implementation/test coverage, and requests no edits.
Executed review start/read and exact baseline comparison; no behavioral tests or workspace build executed by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and root build are separate execution evidence. All additional relied-on source context was captured through review read.
